name: Humans
overview: Scripture reveals that humans are uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, given dominion over the earth and its creatures, and formed by God breathing life into dust. Though small and fragile in comparison to God's greatness, humans are deeply valued by Him, as evidenced by His mindful care and the gift of eternal life through His Son. At death, the body returns to dust, but the spirit returns to God, highlighting the divine origin and eternal destiny of humanity.
